about: Figma source of truth for Game Core Style 2 (READY_UI_STYLE_2, id style-2): the Refill Hearts window (LivesWindowView). Read 2026-10-02 through the Figma MCP: get_metadata, read-only use_figma dumps, get_screenshot with contentsOnly (transparent renders), download_assets (raw image). Coordinates are Figma units of the 1080 x 2344 screen frame = Ready UI design units = the Lives layout's frame coordinates.

snapshot.label: provisional approved snapshot
snapshot.note: The artist is still working on Style 2: this is the approved state the current implementation follows, not a frozen style. To see what changed: re-read the node ids below (boxes, fills, text styles, main components) and re-render the screen / the leaf nodes, then diff against reference/ and png/ (see README.md).

rasters: get_screenshot (contentsOnly) of plain-id nodes = Figma's own transparent render. The two button surfaces are top-level instances whose text / icons are siblings in their group, so their renders are the bare surfaces. The price coin is a plain rectangle with a 256 x 256 transparent raster fill (FILL on a square): its raw image (download_assets) is the source, drawn at 46 x 46 units, 2 px per unit.

assets.note: btn_green 8:22858 (component 8:17579): a vertical gradient, so only the width stretches (top + bottom caps = the height minus the strip); the left / right caps = the r41 corner + 7 inset, grown to the measured edge + gutter
